summary: Q1 FY2027 revenue fell 8% sequentially due to planned maintenance; EBITDA per ton rose to INR 1,197, up INR 1,843 from prior quarter.
Value-added products reached 66% of sales vs 61% previously; company prioritizes specialty steel over commodity capacity expansion.
Full-year sales guidance maintained at 10.5-11 million tons; Q2 margins expected flat at ~INR 12,000/ton despite softer steel prices.
Cost savings targeted via slurry pipeline (INR 700/ton), captive coal ramp-up, and iron ore integration rising to 40% from 28% in Q1.
Net debt at INR 15,927 crore with 1.71x debt-to-EBITDA; management targets sub-1.5x in Q2 under disciplined 'earn and invest' approach.
